headline: Bajaj Electricals gets GST relief of ₹29.63 lakh
summary: Bajaj Electricals received a favourable appellate order setting aside a GST demand of ₹29.63 lakh for FY18, including a penalty of ₹2.69 lakh.

headline: Xtranet AGM approves all five resolutions
summary: Xtranet Technologies passed all five resolutions at its 25th AGM, including re-appointments of directors and adoption of FY26 financials.

headline: Signoria Creation wins Rs 2.85 crore order from Zivore Apparel
summary: Signoria Creation secured a Rs 2.85 crore work order for garment manufacturing. The order represents 5.8% of average quarterly revenue. No prior order history disclosed in last 3 quarters.

headline: Jaipan Industries shareholders approve FY26 financials
summary: Jaipan Industries Limited shareholders approved the adoption of audited financial statements for FY26 and reappointment of a director at its 60th AGM.

headline: Tandhan Power reappoints auditor for 5-year term
summary: Tandhan Energies Limited announced the re-appointment of M/s. N. Agarwala & Associates as statutory auditors of its material subsidiary, Tandhan Power Technologies Private Limited, for a second five-year term.

headline: Oscar Global AGM approves all nine resolutions
summary: Oscar Global Limited passed all nine resolutions at its 35th AGM, including director regularisations and capital increase. Voting showed 97.21% support.

headline: Liqvd Digital appoints Sonal Biyani as CS
summary: Liqvd Digital India Limited appointed Sonal Dilip Biyani as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective July 16, 2025, in compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Niks Technology passes 12 AGM resolutions
summary: Niks Technology Limited approved all 12 resolutions at its 12th AGM, including preferential share issues and capital changes. Voting saw zero dissent.

headline: Ravindra Energy promoter pledges 7.57 lakh shares
summary: Khandepar Investments Private Limited, a promoter entity of Ravindra Energy Limited, created a pledge on 7,57,000 equity shares valued at ₹11.21 crore.

headline: Godavari Biorefineries secures Mexican patent
summary: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd has received a patent grant from the Mexican Patent Office for compounds treating viral infections. The patent, valid until 2041, covers V-ATPase inhibition.
